This is the strongest return potential this week. We've covered 5 analysts. Let's go forward. After going through all 5 forecasts, here's the numeric view. By collecting the forecast side by side, I've drawn a consolidated consensus outlook. The consensus forecast suggests XRP could rise by about 1.1%. All right, let's dig in.
